title: Ich hätte eine Bitte
desc: Four messages, two hours, and four yeses
setting: A Monday evening, a phone, and a Saturday you have been planning to do alone for three weeks.

options.en: I have a favour to ask.
options.feedback: The opening. It warns him something is coming and it gives him room to say no.
Two hours to write the message and then you take it back in five words.
Fine, and it makes him say yes before he knows to what. Say the thing.

options.es: Könntest du mir am Samstag beim Umzug helfen?
options.en: Could you help me with the move on Saturday?
options.feedback: What, and when. Nothing else belongs in this sentence.

options.es: Ich weiss, du hast sicher viel zu tun, aber...
options.en: I know you have a lot on, but...
options.feedback: You are arguing against yourself before he has said anything.

options.es: Kennst du jemanden mit einem Camion?
options.en: Do you know anybody with a van?
options.feedback: Asking sideways. He will answer the question you asked and not the one you have.
A time and the payment. That is the whole arrangement and everybody here knows it.

options.es: Bist du sicher? Es ist ein ganzer Tag.
options.en: Are you sure? It is a whole day.
options.feedback: He said klar. Asking again makes him say it twice and helps nobody.
Money for this is an insult. Food and drink, and that is not a joke.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.es: Und? Was ist mit dem Rücken?

options.feedback: Say it. Nobody will mention it again and nobody will let you near the cupboard.
He will not believe it and he will hand you a carton anyway.
Nobody is going to let you. Beat decides that at nine in the morning.
